results.title: What Kane proves on the scam page reaches Meena's next reply
results.summary:
Opened a new chat and selected the “Bank KYC update” practice scam before sending it for investigation.
Waited for Kane’s investigation to confirm the result, which identified the recipient as bharatunity.kyc@demoupi.
Sent “Did you do it? Hurry up.” and received Meena’s reply, which said she had not done it yet and referenced Bharat Unity Bank and 10 rupees.
Meena’s reply was marked as using Kane’s finding.
